Title: EVT-OP-013: Hill estimator for preferential-attachment degree data
Labels: open-problem, area:statistics, type:research, difficulty:hard, status:research

**Status in the survey:** Stated as open in 2020; current status unverified.

## Source and quote
Drees, Janßen, Resnick and Wang, arXiv:1811.06433:

> asymptotic normality of the Hill estimator in this setting remains an open problem

The quote was extracted from the source text, with symbols flattened; check it against the published version before citing.

## Why it matters
It concerns the use of the Hill estimator on network degree data.

## What the library already has
Hill consistency and normality for iid data, and consistency for dependent data.

## What is missing
Network models. The survey rates this as out of reach.
